blocks.html: The options of a vector, or semantic, search.

types.name: field
types.description: The dotted path of the `vector` field to search in.

types.name: value
types.description: A pre-computed embedding to search with. Mutually exclusive with `query`.

types.name: query
types.description:
Text to embed with the index's configured embedder. Mutually exclusive with
`value`.

types.name: semantic_ratio
types.description:
How much the semantic score contributes relative to the keyword score, where
`0` is keyword-only and `1` is semantic-only.
